name: Two Factor (TOTP)
description: Adds a two-step login page (password, then TOTP code) that opens the Jellyfin session only after both factors are valid. Personal prototype.
overview: TOTP two-factor login page for Jellyfin

versions.changelog: Two-factor authentication (TOTP) for Jellyfin 12.1 - Two-screen login: username and password, then the code from the authenticator app. - Authenticator enrollment with a QR code, protected by a single-use invitation code generated by an administrator. - Users can replace their own authenticator, and administrators can manage invitations and reset authenticators. - Blocks Jellyfin's password-only login; includes an emergency bypass through an environment variable. - Seeds encrypted with AES-256-GCM (TWOFACTOR_KEY key), replay protection and temporary lockout after failed attempts. - Works with Quick Connect and forgotten password; pages in Spanish and English.
